violations.description: pull_request_target workflow checks out untrusted PR head code and executes a script from it with secrets and write-all permissions.
violations.evidence:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with:
    ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
...
  run: |
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    python scripts/publish_preview.py
violations.recommendation: Avoid using pull_request_target with head.sha checkout and execution of untrusted scripts; use pull_request instead or do not execute PR-authored code with secrets.

violations.description: CI workflow triggers on 'master' branch whereas the repository's default branch is 'main'.
CI workflow masks test failures by appending '|| true'.
violations.recommendation: Remove '|| true' so that test failures correctly fail the CI pipeline.

violations.description: Overly broad write-all token permissions granted to the workflow.
violations.recommendation: Grant only the minimum required permissions (e.g., contents: read).

violations.description: Potential script injection via untrusted event data interpolated directly into run command.
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Hardcoded credential present in git history.
violations.evidence: commit c436888 scripts/deploy.sh [hardcoded_credential] (file no longer tracked) DEPLOY_TOKEN="[REDACTED:len=28]"
violations.recommendation: Revoke the exposed credential and rewrite git history or rotate secrets.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in configuration/code.
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables for data directories.

violations.description: Inconsistent dependency specifications between pyproject.toml and requirements.txt.
violations.recommendation: Align dependency versions across all manifests.

violations.description: Committed IDE settings file containing user-specific absolute paths.
violations.recommendation: Add .vscode/settings.json to .gitignore or remove machine-specific settings.
